zh-Hant.home.sub: 動物園裡的小蛇大賽：吃果實、變長、別撞到！
zh-Hant.home.rec.solo: 對戰電腦 {w} 勝／{p} 場
zh-Hant.fig.eat.alt: 小蛇朝手指或按鍵的方向游過去，吃到果實就變長
zh-Hant.fig.eat.cap: 往想去的方向游、吃果實變長變粗
zh-Hant.fig.crash.alt: 撞到石頭、自己或別條蛇的身體就會出局；碰到圍欄不會出局，但會扣掉加速能量；草叢可以直接穿過去
zh-Hant.fig.crash.cap: 碰到就出局，身體變成發光果實
zh-Hant.help.title: 怎麼玩
zh-Hant.help.goal.p: 操控你的動物小蛇在動物園圓形場地裡自由游動，吃果實越長越粗。別撞到石頭、自己或別條蛇的身體！碰到圍欄不會出局，但會扣掉加速能量；草叢可以直接穿過去。
zh-Hant.help.goal.n: 對戰：最後還活著的蛇獲勝；時間到時分數最高的獲勝。單人挑戰：看你能拿幾分。
zh-Hant.help.ctl.touch: 平板與手機：手指按在畫面任何地方拖曳，就像搖桿一樣，小蛇會往拖的方向游；按住「加速」鈕衝刺（設定裡可以改成固定位置的搖桿、換左右手）。
zh-Hant.help.ctl.energy: 加速會用掉能量條，碰到圍欄也會扣能量；放開加速、離開圍欄後會慢慢充回來，用光要等一下才能再衝。
zh-Hant.help.fruit.1: 各種水果（蘋果、橘子、梨子、蜜桃、檸檬、李子、櫻桃、藍莓）：+10 分，身體變長一點。
zh-Hant.help.fruit.2: 金色星星：+30 分，一口氣長很多；只會出現 15 秒，閃爍時要趕快！
zh-Hant.help.fruit.3: 發光果實：出局的蛇變的，一顆 +5 分。
zh-Hant.help.fruit.4: 越長越粗，但轉彎也會變得比較大圈。單人挑戰每吃 5 顆會變快一點。
zh-Hant.help.out.1: 撞到石頭、自己的身體或別條蛇的身體。碰到圍欄不會出局，只會扣加速能量；草叢不會擋路，可以穿過去。
zh-Hant.help.out.2: 兩條蛇的頭撞在一起，一起出局。
zh-Hant.help.out.3: 出局的蛇整條變成發光果實，留給活著的人搶。
zh-Hant.help.out.4: 小蛇不能原地掉頭，要繞一個小圈；加速時圈會更大，要小心。
zh-Hant.help.out.5: 出局後可以點資訊欄（或上方分數列）的玩家，包含電腦，切換觀看的視角；觀戰者也一樣。
zh-Hant.help.mode.challenge.d: 一個人衝高分，成績會記在這台裝置上。
zh-Hant.help.mode.solo.d: 和 1～7 隻電腦動物比賽，每隻電腦可以各自選難度。
zh-Hant.help.mode.online.d: 建立房間、用邀請連結叫朋友，也可以加電腦或進去觀戰。
zh-Hant.prof.placeholder: 幫自己取個名字（最多 {n} 字）
zh-Hant.ch.title: 單人挑戰
zh-Hant.ch.play.p: 一個人在舞台上衝高分。每吃 5 顆果實，小蛇就會加快一級；撞到石頭或自己就結束，碰到圍欄只會扣加速能量。
zh-Hant.solo.title: 對戰電腦
zh-Hant.solo.win.p: 撞到石頭或蛇身就出局，最後還活著的獲勝。有設時間的話，時間到時分數最高的獲勝。
zh-Hant.menu.pause.online: 線上對局不會暫停，其他人還在繼續。

zh-Hant.leave.text: 離開後會回到線上大廳。

zh-Hans.help.fruit.2: 金色星星：+30 分，一口气长很多；只会出现 15 秒，闪烁时要赶快！
zh-Hans.help.fruit.3: 发光果实：出局的蛇变的，一颗 +5 分。

en.home.sub: Zoo snake showdown: eat, grow, survive!

en.help.title: How to play
en.help.goal.p: Steer your animal snake freely around the round zoo arena and eat fruit to grow longer and thicker. Don't hit rocks, yourself or another snake! Touching the fence won't put you out, but it drains your boost energy; bushes can be driven right through.
en.help.goal.n: Versus: the last snake alive wins; when time is up the highest score wins. Solo challenge: see how many points you can get.
en.help.ctl.touch: Tablet & phone: press anywhere on the screen and drag like a joystick, and the snake swims that way. Hold the Boost button to sprint (Settings lets you switch to a fixed joystick or swap hands).
en.help.ctl.energy: Boosting uses the energy bar, and touching the fence drains it too. It slowly refills once you let go and leave the fence; if it runs out, wait a moment before sprinting again.
en.help.fruit.1: Fruit of all kinds (apple, orange, pear, peach, lemon, plum, cherry, blueberry): +10 points, grow a little.
en.help.fruit.2: Gold star: +30 points, grow a lot; it only lasts 15 seconds, hurry when it blinks!
en.help.fruit.3: Glowing orbs: made from snakes that are out, +5 points each.
en.help.fruit.4: The longer you get, the thicker you are and the wider your turns. In solo challenge you speed up after every 5 fruits.
en.help.out.1: Hitting a rock, your own body or another snake's body. Touching the fence won't put you out, it only drains boost energy; bushes don't block you, so drive right through.
en.help.out.2: Two heads crashing together puts both out.
en.help.out.3: A snake that is out turns into glowing fruit for the survivors to grab.
en.help.out.4: You can't turn on the spot; you loop around in a small circle, and boosting makes the circle wider, so be careful.
en.help.out.5: Once you are out, tap a player (computers included) in the info panel or the score bar to switch the camera to them. Spectators can do the same.
en.help.mode.challenge.d: Chase a high score alone; scores are saved on this device.
en.help.mode.solo.d: Race 1–7 computer animals, each with its own difficulty.
en.help.mode.online.d: Create a room, invite friends with a link, add computers, or just watch.
en.ch.title: Solo challenge
en.ch.play.p: Chase a high score alone. Every 5 fruits the snake speeds up one level; hitting a rock or yourself ends the run, while the fence only drains boost energy.
en.solo.title: Vs computer
en.solo.win.p: Hit a rock or a snake body and you're out; the last one alive wins. With a time limit, the highest score wins when time is up.
